title: CI mobile/touch canary for configurable Habits
mission: Turn the remaining mobile/touch acceptance gate into a reproducible GitHub Actions canary without changing the configurable-Habits candidate or any Current/Human Accepted/Served pointer. Reuse the proven Chromium harness, add a dedicated 390x844 touch-emulated Playwright context (hasTouch/mobile semantics), exercise the real controls with tap/scroll/dialog interactions, persist screenshots plus machine-readable evidence, and make the workflow run automatically from the implementation commit.
definition_of_done: A dedicated Playwright mobile/touch canary exists for candidate/calendar-habits-custom-trackers-v1 and uses a representative 390x844 touch-enabled Chromium context rather than only desktop click automation.

The canary uses touch/tap interactions to switch Calendar/Habits/Money, open and operate tracker configuration controls, exercise scrolling/range navigation, and open/close dialogs without dead zones or unintended activation.
The canary asserts no accidental horizontal page overflow or clipped/overlapping primary controls at the mobile viewport and records exact viewport/browser observations.
Screenshots and machine-readable evidence are uploaded as a GitHub Actions artifact even on failure.
The workflow is triggered by the implementation commit without requiring manual workflow_dispatch authority, and the resulting run is inspected and recorded.
Candidate bytes and Current/Human Accepted/Served/Catalog pointers remain unchanged.
